description: Readiness Check / SI-Check findings scoped per module, plus (when the full Readiness Check report was analyzed, not just an SI-Check export) the full multi-chapter findings brief. Produced by readiness-analysis, checked by the discover→prepare Q-gate. Distinct from assessment-report (agent-readiness's agent-candidate scoring).

source_exports.description: Which exports were triaged and their date, e.g. 'Readiness Check export 2026-08-01, SI-Check export 2026-08-01, scope: FI/CO/SD'.

executive_risk_summary.description: Genuine blockers or business decisions needed before the conversion can be properly scoped (e.g. CVI not complete, custom code analysis never run, an incompatible add-on). Optional — populated only when the full Readiness Check report (not just an SI-Check export) was analyzed.

data_collection_gaps.description: Chapters/subsections that came back empty due to missing analysis — reported as 'impact unknown', never silently dropped or conflated with a genuinely clean result.

chapter_findings.description: Per-chapter findings across the full Readiness Check report (Simplification Items, Custom Code, HANA Sizing, Integration, Financial Data Quality, Fiori/Business Process Discovery, Planned Downtime, Customer Vendor Integration). Optional — populated only when the full report was analyzed, not just an SI-Check export.

summary.description: The concrete number(s) behind the call, not just a qualitative label.

sad_section.description: Which SAD template section this finding feeds, once sad-drafting exists.

reason.description: Why this genuinely blocks, or why it doesn't apply — the judgment this report exists to make explicit.
